title: China Forum of Veterinary Cardiology (CFVC) 2025
description:
Over the past, through the CFVC conference, we have had the privilege of connecting with veterinary professionals from all around the world. Each encounter has been an valuable asset to us.

In 2025, we are excited to bring CFVC - an outstanding platform for global veterinary exchange, to Bangkok, Thailand—a vibrant city known for its rich culture, warmth, and dynamic energy. The congress will be held from 11th to 13th September, 2025 in the Bangkok Marriott Hotel The Surawongse. With an exceptional lineup of world-class speakers, diverse and immersive courses, unparalleled networking opportunities, and cutting-edge innovations in veterinary technology and services showcased in the exhibition area, we believe this event will once again mark a milestone event in the veterinary field. We also hope Bangkok, the City of Angels, will provide each attendee with a fresh and inspiring experience, blending professional growth with an enjoyable and enriching atmosphere. Most importantly, we look forward to fostering new connections, deepening friendships, and advancing both practical and academic veterinary knowledge together.
scale: 180+ estimated participants from 20+ countries, featuring 6+ speakers and guests — a super lineup on an international platform covering frontier topics in veterinary cardiology.

sponsors.name: Shanghai Hongyu Medical
sponsors.intro: Established in 2019, Shanghai Hongyu Medical Technology Co., Ltd. is a global leader in veterinary cardiology, focusing on the diagnosis and treatment of heart diseases in pets. With its core product, the V-Clamp for minimally invasive mitral valve disease treatment in dogs, Hongyu Medical is expanding into diagnostics, treatment, and monitoring for various cardiac conditions, offering a comprehensive solution for pet heart disease. In addition to developing, manufacturing, and selling veterinary cardiac devices, Hongyu Medical promotes collaboration and knowledge-sharing among veterinarians worldwide by providing training on heart disease diagnosis, treatment, and care for animals.

sponsors.name: GE HealthCare
sponsors.intro: GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology, pharmaceutical diagnostics, and digital solutions innovator, dedicated to providing integrated solutions, services, and data analytics to make hospitals more efficient, clinicians more effective, therapies more precise, and patients healthier and happier. Serving patients and providers for more than 100 years, GE HealthCare is advancing personalized, connected, and compassionate care, while simplifying the patient’s journey across the care pathway. Together our Imaging, Ultrasound, Patient Care Solutions, and Pharmaceutical Diagnostics businesses help improve patient care from prevention and screening, to diagnosis, treatment, therapy, and monitoring. We are an $18 billion business with 51,000 employees working to create a world where healthcare has no limits.

sponsors.name: Bangkok Heart Animal Hospital
sponsors.intro: Bangkok Heart Animal Hospital is a leading veterinary cardiology center in Bangkok, Thailand, operating three branches across the city. The hospital specializes in comprehensive diagnosis and treatment of heart diseases in pets, including cardiac surgery and 24-hour cardiology care. With a mission to extend the lifespan of animals through advanced heart care, Bangkok Heart provides state-of-the-art diagnostic technology, specialized cardiac treatment, and a multidisciplinary team of veterinary experts (e.g., orthopedic, imaging, dermatology, ophthalmology, etc.). The hospital also promotes knowledge exchange through training programs and collaborations with veterinarians across Asia, North America, and Europe aiming to raise the standard of pet heart care in a sustainable and impactful way.

sponsors.name: Thonglor International Pet Hospital
sponsors.intro: Thonglor International Pet Hospital is a leading animal hospital in Bangkok, Thailand, offering a comprehensive range of services for pets. Renowned for its advanced medical technology and specialised care, the hospital provides high-quality treatment for a variety of pet needs. From routine check-ups and vaccinations to complex surgeries, cardiology and emergency care, the hospital’s dedicated team of veterinarians and staff are committed to ensuring the health and well-being of pets. It operates 24/7 and has various specialized centers, including internal medicine, cardiology, dermatology, ophthalmology, neurology, oncology behavior, dentistry, rehabilitaion, acupuncture and diagnostic imaging. The hospital also provides services such as grooming, pet swimming pools, pet hotel, pet park, pet taxi,restaurant In addition, there are 23 branches in bangkok and surrounding areas, as well as locations in Chiang Mai, Pattaya and Phuket. Website: www.thonglorpet.com

sponsors.name: Shanghai Xinyu Animal Hospital
sponsors.intro: Founded in 2019, Shanghai Xinyu Animal (Cardiac Specialty) Hospital is a flagship cardiac specialty hospital under Shanghai Hongyu Medical. As the first veterinary heart hospital in China to perform minimally invasive mitral valve surgery, Xinyu provides specialized cardiac treatments and advanced services for pets nationwide. The hospital also offers training and technical support for global veterinary hospitals and medical centers, drawing on a skilled veterinary and post-care team and state-of-the-art medical equipment. Services include minimally invasive mitral valve regurgitation surgery and hands-on device training for domestic and international experts. By the end of 2024, Xinyu had provided V-Clamp technology training to over 70 hospitals worldwide.

sponsors.name: Shanghai Quanxin Medical Technology
sponsors.intro: Shanghai Quanxin Medical Technology Co., Ltd. was established in 2022 and is headquartered in Minhang District, Shanghai. As a medical technology company specializing in the cardiovascular health industry, Quanxin Medical has accumulated deep expertise and holds a leading technological position in the field of valve replacement. The company is committed to providing safe, efficient, and comprehensive valve replacement solutions for heart disease patients.
